summary: The filing is an 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting that a subsidiary received notification of project withdrawal from a Hydrogen IPCEI program due to failure to meet internal requirements. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change occurred. This is a routine disclosure of a program setback, not a special situation.
